description: This file defines an interface IStreamIdMapper for mapping StreamId objects to GrainId.Key components within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: IStreamIdMapper
classes.description: Interface for components that map a StreamId to a GrainId.Key.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Returns the GrainId.Key associated with a given StreamId, using provided GrainBindings.
